description: This Java source file defines the abstract class ServiceOrder, which provides properties and methods for various types of medical service orders within the OpenMRS platform. It includes order-specific attributes such as specimen source, laterality, clinical history, frequency, number of repeats, and location, along with their respective getters and setters. The class also features copy and clone helper methods for managing order instances.

classes.name: ServiceOrder
classes.description: An abstract class representing various types of medical service orders, providing common properties such as specimen source, laterality, clinical history, frequency, repeats, and location, with methods to manage and clone order instances.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Copies the properties from this ServiceOrder to the target ServiceOrder instance.

methods.name: cloneForRevisionHelper
methods.description: Creates a clone of this ServiceOrder for revision purposes, copying relevant properties to the target instance.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuingHelper
methods.description: Prepares a clone of this ServiceOrder for discontinuation, setting necessary properties and action.

methods.name: getSpecimenSource
methods.description: Returns the concept representing the specimen source.

methods.name: setSpecimenSource
methods.description: Sets the concept representing the specimen source.

methods.name: getLaterality
methods.description: Returns the laterality (side) involved in the order.

methods.name: setLaterality
methods.description: Sets the laterality (side) for the order.

methods.name: getClinicalHistory
methods.description: Returns the clinical history associated with the order.

methods.name: setClinicalHistory
methods.description: Sets the clinical history for the order.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency of the order.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the frequency of the order.

methods.name: getNumberOfRepeats
methods.description: Returns the number of repeats for the order.

methods.name: setNumberOfRepeats
methods.description: Sets the number of repeats for the order.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location associated with the order.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location for the order.
